name: MalOvent
source:
For [YOU].

Never settle for those awkward feelings of being alone ever again. MalO is an exciting and interactive experience that will keep you engaged and intrigued. The anxiety of social situations can be nerve-racking, but after just a few hours of MalO you will soon forget all about those painful emotions of disappointment...

MalOvent is an adult horror visual novel centered around SCP-1471. Over the course of play you'll be presented with choices that matter not only for you as the main character, but for the greater world around you. Will you be able to unearth the truth before the walls come crashing down?

[From [url=https://night-fox-works.itch.io/malovent]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对于[YOU]。

永远不要再满足于孤独的尴尬感觉。MalO是一种令人兴奋的互动体验，会让你保持参与和好奇。社交场合的焦虑可能会让人伤脑筋，但经过几个小时的MalO，你很快就会忘记那些痛苦的失望情绪……

MalOvent是一部以SCP-1471为中心的成人恐怖视觉小说。在游戏过程中，你会面临一些选择，这些选择不仅对你作为主角很重要，而且对你周围的更广阔的世界也很重要。你能在围墙倒塌之前找出真相吗？

[来自[url=https://night-fox-works.itch.io/malovent]Itch.io[/url]]
